agent_messages: The organizing principle is that semicontinuity is inherited from continuity and is stable under composition with continuous order-preserving operations. In particular, addition is jointly continuous and monotone in an ordered additive monoid, so adding two upper-semicontinuous functions preserves upper semicontinuity.
